decision.zh: 先用 Choice 路由；再用 Noul 判断原请求与答案是否包含值得记住的长期客户事实。
decision.en: A Choice routes the ticket, then a Noul judges whether the original request and answer contain lasting customer facts worth retaining.

action.zh: 代码在 P(值得记忆)≥0.5 时按客户 ID 存入 Python dict；下次请求前把已有记忆加入 state，无论是否保存均返回路由答案。
action.en: Code stores tickets/answers by customer ID in a Python dict when the memory probability reaches 0.5, injects saved memories into later state and returns the routing answer either way.

boundary.zh: 官方两名虚构客户、六个后续工单的小样例；0.5 是待评估起点，字典不是生产持久化/保留期限方案。效果仅官方自报，本站未运行 API 或复现改善。
boundary.en: An official toy example with two fictional customers and six later tickets. The 0.5 threshold needs evaluation, and a dict is not production persistence or retention management. Results are official reports, not independently reproduced here.

title.zh: ego-jev：让封闭判断完成多步浏览器流程
title.en: ego-jev: closed judgments drive multi-step browser flows

input.zh: 当前页面的有限控件、目标、调用方给定值与可见状态要求。
input.en: Current bounded page controls, a goal, caller-provided values and visible-state requirements.

decision.zh: Jev 判断动作、目标元素和所用给定值；要求检查用 Noul，完成后再询问目标是否实际呈现在页面上。
decision.en: Jev judges actions, target elements and supplied values; Nouls check requirements and a final verification rechecks visible goal completion.

action.zh: 代码通过 ego 执行操作并更新页面快照，再继续循环，返回操作记录和完成/不确定状态。
action.en: Code acts through ego, refreshes page snapshots and continues the loop, returning actions and completion/uncertainty status.

boundary.zh: 需 ego/macOS；不可逆操作选项和源码检查不是独立权限保证。页面上下文发送模型，作者配对速度/成功样例未复现，本站未操作真实账号或表单。
boundary.en: Requires ego/macOS. Irreversible-action options and source checks are not independently verified authorization guarantees. Page context goes to the model; author timing/success examples and real-account/form actions were not reproduced here.

title.zh: MIDI 量化：音值概率与代码的小节约束结合
title.en: MIDI quantization: combine note-value probabilities with bar constraints

input.zh: 单小节钢琴 MIDI 的音高、起音时间、间隔、按键长度与拍号。
input.en: Pitches, onset times, gaps, key durations and time signature from one bar of piano MIDI.

decision.zh: 每个起音一个 Jev Choice，从全音符、四分、附点、三连音等有限音值中返回概率；起始休止也用有限候选。
decision.en: One Jev Choice per onset returns probabilities over finite whole, quarter, dotted, triplet and other note values, with bounded initial-rest options.

action.zh: 代码用动态规划寻找符合小节长度的序列并输出记谱/对照评测；无可行整小节解时退回逐项最高概率。
action.en: Code uses dynamic programming to find a bar-length-compatible sequence for notation/comparison, falling back to per-item top probabilities when no exact fill is feasible.

boundary.zh: 作者仅30个单小节，阈值有事后选择，不能外推完整曲目质量。仓库许可未确认，仅作代码案例；本站未下载演奏数据、调用模型或复现准确率。
boundary.en: Author evaluation covers only 30 single bars with post-hoc threshold selection, not full-piece quality. Licensing is unconfirmed, so this is a code case only. Performance data, model calls and accuracy were not reproduced here.

title.zh: Bayes：选择暂定行程或继续补查
title.en: Bayes: choose a tentative itinerary or request more research

input.zh: 确认的出游需求/偏好、地图和官网线索、代码生成的行程备选与未解问题。
input.en: Confirmed outing needs/preferences, map/site clues, code-generated itinerary alternatives and open questions.

decision.zh: 选择 Jev 引擎时，经 TypeSafeModelFactory 在有限备选与 research 中做 Choice，并作有限证据/适配判断。
decision.en: With the Jev engine selected, TypeSafeModelFactory makes a Choice over bounded alternatives and research, with typed evidence/fit judgments.

action.zh: 代码显示选中的暂定方案、来源和缺口；信息不足返回补问/研究状态，没有自动预订或无限研究循环。
action.en: Code displays a selected tentative plan, sources and gaps, returning clarification/research when needed without automatic bookings or an unbounded research loop.

boundary.zh: 默认本地规则，远端模型及地图另需同意；地图标签/网页摘要不证明当前营业或交通。Snapshot依赖与作者比较未复现，其他引擎效果不混称 Jev。
boundary.en: Defaults to local rules with separate remote-model/map consent. Map tags/site snippets do not prove current hours or traffic. Snapshot dependencies and author comparisons were not reproduced, and other engines are not reported as Jev.

title.zh: 评论洞察：Jev 分类后用代码汇总产品问题
title.en: Review insights: Jev classification before coded issue aggregation

input.zh: 去重后的评论文本，每批最多五条，以及有限主题、意图、严重程度和情感标准。
input.en: Deduplicated review text in batches of up to five, with bounded topic, intent, severity and sentiment rubrics.

decision.zh: Jev 用 Choice/Score 返回四类标签和概率；代码按 ID、标签范围与输出合同校验。
decision.en: Jev Choices/Scores return four labels and probabilities, validated in code against IDs, allowed labels and output contracts.

action.zh: 代码保存结果、复用完全重复文本，隔离未完成/异常行；按已完成记录的严重程度总和等计算排名，再由另一模型生成带证据的 memo。
action.en: Code saves results, reuses exact duplicates and quarantines unfinished/invalid rows; completed records feed deterministic severity-sum rankings before another model writes an evidence-linked memo.

boundary.zh: 作者只完成全量数据的一部分，不把其余待处理行算分类。样本准确率、成本和产品建议均为作者结果，许可未确认仅作案例；本站未复制评论数据或运行流水线。
boundary.en: Only part of the full source was classified; pending rows are not counted as classifications. Sample quality, costs and product recommendations are author results. Licensing is unconfirmed, and this site did not copy review data or run the pipeline.

title.zh: 两阶段邮件判断：返回处理信号和回复标签
title.en: Two-stage email judgments: handling signals and reply labels

input.zh: 邮件发送者、主题和正文描述。
input.en: A description of the email sender, subject and body.

decision.zh: 第一轮六类 Choice、紧急 Score、需回复/人工 Noul；代码允许后第二轮选择四种语气、六种意图及可自动处理概率。
decision.en: First-round six-way Choice, urgency Score and reply/human Nouls; when code permits, a second round selects four tones, six intents and an auto-processing probability.

action.zh: 垃圾/促销返回 archive，通知/简报返回 mute；无需回复跳过第二轮。其余返回 flag_human、auto_draft 或 suggest_reply 标签，无正文和发信操作。
action.en: Spam/promotions return archive; notifications/newsletters return mute. No-reply mail skips round two. Others return flag_human, auto_draft or suggest_reply labels, without prose or sending.

boundary.zh: Python/jevlang 示例；人工判断在第二轮后拦截，标签不是实际归档或发信。0.5/0.60/0.85 是作者起点，正文送模型；本站未运行或校准。
boundary.en: Python/jevlang example; human review gates after round two, and labels do not perform mailbox actions. The 0.5/0.60/0.85 thresholds are author defaults, and bodies reach the model. Not run or calibrated here.

title.zh: OptChat：沿摘要树找回原始聊天记录
title.en: OptChat: recover original chat records through a summary tree

input.zh: 用户提问、二叉摘要视图各行与左右子摘要。
input.en: A user question, binary-summary view lines and child summaries.

decision.zh: OMP judge 角色配置为 Jev 时，每行 Noul 找可能含答案的摘要，再逐层 Choice 选 first/second。
decision.en: When the OMP judge role is Jev, per-line Nouls find likely answer ranges, then a Choice selects first/second at each level.

action.zh: 代码下降到单条原记录，返回路径和首 8KB，余文通过 zoom 读取；未达阈值或失败/超时返回明确状态。
action.en: Code descends to one original record and returns its path and first 8KB, with zoom for the rest. Low relevance, failure and timeout return explicit outcomes.

boundary.zh: 角色可用其他模型，不把所有运行归为 Jev；合成检索实验衡量导航而非真实 Jev 准确率。Linux/Bun/OMP18.9+，许可证未确认仅作代码案例，本站未运行。
boundary.en: The role may use other models, so not all runs are Jev. Synthetic experiments measure navigation, not real Jev accuracy. Linux/Bun/OMP18.9+; licensing is unconfirmed, so this is a code case only and was not run here.

title.zh: 告警路由：模型选通知频道，标签规则兜底
title.en: Alert routing: choose a notification channel with label fallback

input.zh: 告警组、标题/描述、严重程度、主机与持续时间的脱敏摘要。
input.en: A scrubbed alert-group summary with titles/descriptions, severity, hosts and duration.

decision.zh: Jev Choice 在 page now/informational 中判断，另一个 0–4 紧急 Score 仅供日志。
decision.en: A Jev Choice judges page now versus informational; a separate 0–4 urgency Score is logged only.

action.zh: 代码同时检查 confidence 与 P(page now) 后选 Discord 频道；低置信/缺 key/超时/错误按 severity=critical 路由，恢复通知沿用内存记录。
action.en: Code checks confidence and P(page now) to choose a Discord channel. Low confidence, missing keys, timeouts and errors use severity=critical routing, while resolutions reuse the in-memory channel.

boundary.zh: 实验接收器，Sticky 重启后丢失；阈值需本地告警验证，模型不可用不代表投递一定成功。源码有 dry-run/合成测试，本站未部署、调用模型或发送通知。
boundary.en: Experimental receiver; sticky state is lost on restart. Thresholds need local alert evaluation, and model fallback does not guarantee delivery. Source has dry-run/synthetic tests; no deployment, model calls or notifications were made here.

title.zh: Minecraft：可行动作菜单与回合竞争
title.en: Minecraft: feasible action menus and competing turn claims

input.zh: 当前游戏遥测、目标、动作代价/收益与生存、食物、工作的可执行候选。
input.en: Current game telemetry, goals, action costs/gains and feasible survival, food and work claims.

decision.zh: TypeSafe Jev 用有限 Choice/决策树选择动作和 turn_priority，不生成游戏代码；代码保留概率、过时答案与调用记录。
decision.en: TypeSafe Jev uses bounded Choices/decision trees for actions and turn_priority, without generating gameplay code; probabilities, stale answers and calls are recorded.

action.zh: 代码经 Mineflayer 执行菜单项，再根据受伤、失败、状态改变或等待超时重新判断；多数问题在服务不可用时暂停重问。
action.en: Code executes menu items through Mineflayer, then rejudges after harm, failure, changed state or wait expiry. Most questions pause and retry during outages.

boundary.zh: 身体物理问题有代码例外，不把全部动作描述成纯模型。作者未通关，15/40世界进入下界等数字与计费仅作者历史观察，源码随试验变化；本站未运行游戏或复现。
boundary.en: Bodily-physics questions have coded exceptions; not every action is model-only. The author has not beaten the game. Figures such as 15/40 Nether entries and billing are historical author observations, with evolving code; the game was not run here.

title.zh: 技术排障：分开诊断、修复建议与解决验收
title.en: Technical troubleshooting: separate diagnosis, remediation and resolution

input.zh: 用户症状/证据、另一模型的结构化状态与经过验证整合的资料线索。
input.en: User symptoms/evidence, structured state from another model and validated research integration.

decision.zh: Jev Choice 选故障域/下一步；Noul 分别判断诊断成立、修复就绪和解决证据，Score 评紧急程度。
decision.en: Jev Choices select fault domain/next action, Nouls separately judge diagnosis, remediation readiness and resolution evidence, and a Score assesses urgency.

action.zh: 代码依据生命周期、兼容前提与安全检查约束有效动作，再交另一模型写建议并保存 case；修复尝试与解决验收分开。
action.en: Code constrains effective actions through lifecycle, compatibility prerequisites and safety checks, then another model writes advice and the case is saved. Attempted fixes and verified resolution stay separate.

boundary.zh: Windows 开发/评估版，建议不是自动修设备；官方 TypeSafe 与自定义网关分开。离线测试、加密和启发式检查不证明真实诊断准确或全面安全，本站未使用真实故障数据或模型。
boundary.en: Windows development/evaluation build; advice does not automatically repair devices. Official TypeSafe and custom gateways are distinct. Offline tests, encryption and heuristics do not prove diagnosis accuracy or comprehensive security; no real case data or model calls were used here.

title.zh: 简历自查：有限匹配信号转成可解释分数
title.en: Resume self-check: turn bounded fit signals into an explainable score

input.zh: 职位说明与简历全文；另可拆出要求和简历证据单元。
input.en: A full job posting and resume, with optional extracted requirements and evidence units.

decision.zh: 同一 Jev 请求用 Score 判断岗位匹配，Noul 判断经验不足和明确不满足的条件；保留模型与信号。
decision.en: One Jev request uses a Score for role match and Nouls for insufficient experience and a clearly unmet condition, retaining the model and signals.

action.zh: 代码以拟合权重合成 0–100 Match Score，再折减 blocker 概率；CLI/MCP 返回分数，另有逐要求覆盖和证据输出。
action.en: Code combines fitted weights into a 0–100 Match Score and discounts by blocker probability. CLI/MCP returns the score, with separate per-requirement coverage and evidence outputs.

boundary.zh: 面向求职者自查，不自动录用；参照生成模型拟合的一致性不是客观能力或招聘准确率。作者误差、速度与成本未复现；简历文本发送提供商，本站未处理真实简历或调用模型。
boundary.en: For job-seeker self-check, without automatic hiring. Agreement fitted against a generative model is not objective ability or hiring accuracy. Author errors, timing and costs were not reproduced; resume text reaches the provider, and no real resumes or model calls were used here.

title.zh: 官方聊天过滤：分类后由代码隐藏、模糊或突出
title.en: Official chat filtering: hide, blur or highlight after classification

input.zh: 游戏名称、直播标题与一条聊天消息。
input.en: A game name, stream title and one chat message.

decision.zh: 一请求包含五类 Choice（问题/欢呼/交谈/指点/垃圾）和毒性、剧透两个 Noul。
decision.en: One request contains a five-way Choice for question/hype/conversation/backseat/spam and toxic/spoiler Nouls.

action.zh: 代码先按毒性及类别隐藏，再按剧透概率模糊；其他显示或突出问题。每条独立请求、最多八并发，改规则可复用已保存答案。
action.en: Code hides toxic/blocked categories first, then blurs likely spoilers; other messages are shown or questions highlighted. One request per message, up to eight in flight, with reusable saved answers when rules change.

boundary.zh: 官方29个自写英文样本、0.7阈值示例，效果仅官方自报。没有主播进度记忆、实时输入需另接、消息等待可能短暂可见；类别近似平手需自定策略，本站未运行或复现。
boundary.en: Official example with 29 authored English samples and 0.7 thresholds; results are official reports. No streamer-progress memory, live inputs require integration and messages may remain visible while waiting. Close categories need a local policy; not run or reproduced here.

title.zh: Hapsland：把类型设计规则变成编辑后的反馈
title.en: Hapsland: turn type-design rules into feedback after edits

input.zh: 选中的类型或函数声明，以及在配置范围内找到的相关定义与规则问题。
input.en: A selected type/function declaration, related definitions within configured scope and rule questions.

decision.zh: Jev 后端经 Effect TypeSafe 模型为各适用规则做概率判断，例如类型是否允许无意义字段组合。
decision.en: The Jev backend uses Effect TypeSafe probability judgments for applicable rules, such as meaningless field combinations allowed by a type.

action.zh: 代码按规则阈值映射预设反馈，批量送回支持的编码助手；上下文不完整时跳过相关规则。
action.en: Code maps configured thresholds to predefined feedback, batching it for supported coding agents and skipping rules with incomplete context.

boundary.zh: 反馈发生在编辑后，不自动回滚或保证修复，跳过不是通过。可选其他模型，形式化证明有指定范围；根许可证未确认只收案例，选中源码送提供商，本站未安装或运行。
boundary.en: Feedback follows edits without guaranteed rollback or repair, and a skipped rule is not a pass. Other models are optional and proof scope is bounded. Root licensing is unconfirmed, so this is a case only. Selected code reaches the provider; not installed or run here.

title.zh: 信号筛选：Jev 概率决定保留与扫描顺序
title.en: Signal triage: Jev probabilities determine retention and scan order

input.zh: 代码或 Grok 提取的信号、抓取焦点、来源类别与市场数据摘要。
input.en: Signals extracted by code/Grok, crawler focus, source kind and market-data summaries.

decision.zh: 每信号一个 worth Noul，判断是否是具体、符合焦点且值得注意的信息。
decision.en: One worth Noul per signal judges whether information is concrete, relevant to the focus and worth attention.

action.zh: 代码丢弃 P(worth)<默认0.15 的结果，其余按 Jev 概率优先做独立扫描；模型失败继续原流程，延期结果下轮再查。
action.en: Code drops results below the default 0.15 probability and prioritizes independent scans by Jev probability. Model failure retains the original flow, while deferred items are retried later.

boundary.zh: 概率/安全标签不证明可盈利或安全投资；本例仅信息筛选。抓取与市场数据有时效和许可边界，预算进程内，作者速度/费用未复现；本站未抓取、交易或调用模型。
boundary.en: Probabilities/safety labels do not establish profit or investment safety; this case covers information triage only. Source/market freshness and permissions matter, budgets are process-local and author timing/costs were not reproduced. No crawling, trading or model calls here.

title.zh: Scala MCP 实验：Jev 选取证据操作，另一模型写答案
title.en: Scala MCP experiment: Jev selects evidence operations before another model answers

input.zh: Jackson 文档研究目标、MCP 操作的模式目录与已确认的有类型值。
input.en: A Jackson documentation-research goal, MCP operation schemas and confirmed typed values.

decision.zh: Jev 在可绑定参数的操作、过滤或返回证据等有界选项中做下一步判断；另比较预先规划与逐步选择。
decision.en: Jev judges bounded next actions with bindable arguments, filters or evidence return, comparing plan-first with stepwise selection.

action.zh: Scala 宿主执行 MCP、验证/过滤结构化证据并保留检查点，内层返回证据给外层 Bedrock 生成答案，错误恢复有预算。
action.en: The Scala host executes MCP, validates/filters structured evidence and retains checkpoints. The inner loop returns evidence for an outer Bedrock answer, with bounded recovery.

boundary.zh: 应用调用独立 zio-typesafe-ai 库；README 七臂计时是作者单次网络样本，不能据此排名或推算稳定节省。根许可未确认仅案例，模型角色/过滤模式不同，本站未执行 sbt/MCP/模型。
boundary.en: The app calls the separate zio-typesafe-ai library. README timings are one author network sample across seven arms, not a reliable ranking or savings estimate. Root licensing is unconfirmed, so this is a case only. Model/filter roles vary; no sbt, MCP or model execution here.

title.zh: 相关性评分：意图与词项分开，记录重复波动
title.en: Relevance scoring: separate intent and terms, record repeat variability

input.zh: 页面元数据或加正文、作者设定的搜索问题与十个预期词项。
input.en: Page metadata or metadata plus body, an authored search question and ten expected terms.

decision.zh: Jev 两类五级 Score 请求分别判断页面回答意图的程度和各词项中心程度；词项请求不含意图。
decision.en: Two five-level Jev Score request types separately judge intent fulfillment and term centrality; term requests exclude the intent.

action.zh: 代码将等级归一后计算词项和×意图适配，重复测量生成均值/±2SD与过期标记，显示排序和可改进分项，结果存 IndexedDB。
action.en: Code normalizes levels into term-sum times intent-fit scores, repeats measurements for means/±2 SD and stale markers, then displays rankings/improvement components and stores results in IndexedDB.

boundary.zh: 噪声带只是同输入重复答案波动，不是SEO排名、事实正确率或效果校准。源文本仍发送模型；作者十页百次实验未复现，费用随重测累积，本站未评分正式页面或调用API。
boundary.en: Noise bands describe repeated-answer variability, not search ranking, factual accuracy or SEO-effect calibration. Source text reaches the model. The author ten-page/100-run study was not reproduced; repeat calls accumulate costs, and no production pages or APIs were evaluated here.

name: job-drill
author: Kim Jibaek / Korea Management Education Institute

title.zh: 情境回应练习：有限判断与本地标准共同计分
title.en: Scenario-response practice: bounded judgments and local rubrics combine

input.zh: 训练场景、规则、随机资源约束与学员限时写下的回应。
input.en: A practice scenario, rules, randomized resource constraints and a timed learner response.

decision.zh: Jev Choice 选接受/暂缓/拒绝/未知，Score 评两项模拟结果，逐标准及能否兑现承诺用 Noul。
decision.en: A Jev Choice selects accept/defer/decline/unknown, Scores rate two simulated outcomes and Nouls check rubric items and promises.

action.zh: 代码对照情境的参考回应与阈值计算是否通过，记录漏项、时间和练习报告；场景生成与总评另用编码助手。
action.en: Code compares against scenario reference responses and thresholds to compute a pass, recording missing items, timing and practice reports. Coding assistants separately generate scenarios/overall comments.

boundary.zh: 韩文原型与四套 AI 示例，量表不是实际顾客反应或劳动能力认证。回应发送OpenRouter，移动/Windows和进度保存有限；作者费用/速度未复现，本站未测试真实员工。
boundary.en: Korean prototype with four AI-authored packs; scales are not real customer reactions or employee capability certification. Replies reach OpenRouter, with mobile/Windows/persistence limits. Author cost/timing were not reproduced and no real employees were assessed here.

title.zh: 动作级注入检查：分别问来源诱导与任务关联
title.en: Act-level injection check: separate content inducement from task relevance

input.zh: 当前及近期用户请求、前一工具正文、待执行动作和最多十二条动作历史。
input.en: Current/recent requests, preceding tool content, a proposed act and up to twelve prior acts.

decision.zh: 多个 Noul 判断动作是否偏离各请求、是否遵循外来内容；carries 单独判断正文是否诱发了请求未要求的动作。
decision.en: Multiple Nouls judge divergence from each request and following external content; carries separately judges content-induced actions absent from the request.

action.zh: 代码同时满足 carries 与 intent 阈值才返回 flagged，另返回各概率、readable 与原因；本工具本身不阻止动作。
action.en: Code requires both carries and intent thresholds to return flagged, also returning probabilities, readability and reasons. The tool itself does not block acts.

boundary.zh: 默认只看动作400字/正文6000字，存在作者已报告的填充绕过；无语义点击为不可读，不能当作安全。简单攻击集无留出且真实样本单一，作者效果未复现，不替代宿主权限。
boundary.en: Defaults inspect 400 characters of an act and 6,000 of content, with author-documented padding bypasses. Opaque clicks are unreadable, not safe. The simple attack set lacks holdout and real samples are narrow. Author results were not reproduced and do not replace host permissions.

title.zh: 风格密度检查：逐句判断后给出超基线证据
title.en: Style-density check: sentence judgments produce evidence above a baseline

input.zh: Markdown 句子、语境与固定风格问题；长引用从作者风格计数中排除。
input.en: Markdown sentences, context and fixed style questions, excluding substantial quotations from author-style counts.

decision.zh: 固定版本 Jev 对格言、三段式、免责声明等逐句作 Noul；代码校验请求/答案完整性。
decision.en: A pinned Jev model makes per-sentence Nouls for maxims, triplets, disclaimers and other traits, with request/answer completeness checks.

action.zh: 代码按概率算期望计数与每千词密度；90%Poisson下界超过人类基线默认3倍时列出原句和位置，实验编辑另调用生成模型。
action.en: Code computes probability-weighted counts/density, listing source sentences/locations when the 90% Poisson lower bound exceeds the default three-times human baseline. Experimental editing uses a generative model separately.

boundary.zh: 十三篇技术文章基线不代表所有文体/语言，密度不是作者归因或事实质量；短文与引文有单独处理，Node26/API另需配置，作者改写效果与费用未由本站复现。
boundary.en: A 13-technical-post baseline does not represent all genres/languages, and density does not establish authorship or factual quality. Short texts/quotes have special handling. Node 26/API configuration is required, and author editing/cost claims were not reproduced here.

title.zh: 文档人工复核：提取置信与合理性判断独立保留
title.en: Document review: keep extraction confidence and plausibility independent

input.zh: 文档提取字段及行 ID/上下文；原页定位和提取置信另存，不作为 Jev 输入。
input.en: Extracted fields with row IDs/context, while source locations and extraction scores remain separate from Jev input.

decision.zh: 每行一个 Noul 检查提取指令的表面合理性，不读源图、不改值、不评患者个体安全。
decision.en: One Noul per row checks on-face plausibility without reading the source image, changing values or assessing patient-specific safety.

action.zh: 代码保留提取和合理性两类检查，任一缺失/不合法或低于示例阈值即转人工；按行ID和定位回看源文档，高Jev答案不抵消低提取置信。
action.en: Code retains both checks, routing missing/invalid or below-example-threshold values to human review. Row IDs/source locations support inspection, and high Jev answers do not cancel low extraction confidence.

boundary.zh: 商业作者六行处方方法演示，非TypeSafe官方或医疗建议；0.90/0.50待人工文档校验，接近0.50另需策略。作者效果未复现，本站未处理真实医疗数据或调用模型。
boundary.en: A commercial author six-row prescription-method demo, not an official TypeSafe case or medical advice. The 0.90/0.50 cutoffs need reviewed-document validation, with policy for near-0.50 answers. Author results were not reproduced; no real medical data or model calls here.

title.zh: DuckDB：在 SQL 查询里保留有类型判断和分布
title.en: DuckDB: retain typed decisions and distributions inside SQL

input.zh: SQL 表中的工单文本或结构化 JSON、用户问题及有限选项/有序等级。
input.en: Ticket text or structured JSON in SQL rows, user questions and bounded options/ordered levels.

decision.zh: 选定 TypeSafe Jev 且明确允许远程调用后，Noul/Choice/Score 判断写在 SQL 中的问题。
decision.en: With TypeSafe Jev selected and remote calls explicitly enabled, Nouls/Choices/Scores judge questions expressed in SQL.

action.zh: 扩展校验响应并返回标量或分布列，SQL 可据概率做过滤、分组或路由；批处理对相同行复用并限制并发。
action.en: The extension validates responses and returns scalar/distribution columns for SQL filtering, grouping or routing, with duplicate-row reuse and bounded batch concurrency.

boundary.zh: 托管文本会出机，注册/设置不持久化；常数Stub和本地Julia/Laya不算Jev效果。安装渠道与签名有区别，概率/可选校准需本地样本验证，本站未安装或调用。
boundary.en: Hosted text leaves the machine and registrations/settings are not persistent. Constant Stub/local Julia/Laya results are not Jev results. Installation channels/signing vary and probabilities/optional calibration need local samples. Not installed or called here.

title.zh: Sedum：有限元素选择与带标记的概率断言
title.en: Sedum: bounded element selection and flagged probabilistic assertions

input.zh: TypeScript 中的自然语言步骤、可操作元素候选及页面完整摘要。
input.en: Natural-language steps in TypeScript, actionable element candidates and a complete page digest.

decision.zh: 默认 Jev Choice 选目标/none；两个 Noul 分别判断主张成立与页面是否有直接矛盾。
decision.en: By default, a Jev Choice selects a target/none and two Nouls judge claim support and direct contradiction.

action.zh: 代码复核页面新鲜性、元素角色后用 Playwright 执行；断言按阈值/容差产生 passed/failed 和 low_confidence/contradiction 标记，退出策略另处理。
action.en: Code rechecks freshness/element roles before Playwright actions. Thresholds/bands yield assertion pass/fail plus low-confidence/contradiction flags, with a separate exit policy.

boundary.zh: pre-alpha；边缘或矛盾结果可能是passed+flag，不等于严格无歧义通过。另选Clef不混称Jev，作者月成本是情景估算、速度小样本未复现；本站未运行外部测试或提交账号。
boundary.en: Pre-alpha; marginal or contradicted results may pass with flags rather than being unambiguous passes. Optional Clef runs are separate. Author monthly costs are scenario estimates and small timing samples were not reproduced; no external tests or accounts were used here.

title.zh: 模拟器图像定位：存在判断与 Box 门控后点击
title.en: Simulator image localization: tap after presence and Box gates

input.zh: 合成应用截图、目标、历史与调用方描述的目标目录，另给模拟器逻辑尺寸。
input.en: A synthetic-app screenshot, goal, history and caller-described target catalog, with simulator logical dimensions.

decision.zh: Jev1.14 Choice 选目标/操作，Noul 检查目标可见，Box 返回归一化边界；边缘结果允许一次放大复查。
decision.en: Jev 1.14 Choices select target/operation, a Noul checks visibility and a Box returns normalized edges, with one closer recheck for marginal results.

action.zh: 代码校验范围、存在/定位置信及状态新鲜性，将框中心换算为模拟器点，经 AXe 执行再观察；模型完成与独立持久化状态验收分开。
action.en: Code validates ranges, presence/localization beliefs and freshness, maps the box center to simulator points and acts through AXe before observing again. Model completion and independent persisted-state acceptance stay separate.

boundary.zh: 官方视觉/Box为实验状态；作者三段1.14演示及旧合成评测不证明通用App准确率，定位方案还混有模型/候选差异。需macOS/Xcode/AXe和自备提供商，本站未操作模拟器或调用模型。
boundary.en: Official vision/Box support is experimental. Three author 1.14 demos and older synthetic evaluations do not establish general app accuracy; models/catalogs also differ. Requires macOS/Xcode/AXe and providers. No simulator actions or model calls here.

title.zh: 流程图：Jev 选有限节点关系，复核后代码生成
title.en: Flowcharts: Jev selects bounded relations before reviewed code generation

input.zh: 最多八行用户步骤及关系说明，节点文字由用户提供。
input.en: Up to eight user-authored steps plus relationship instructions, retaining supplied node labels.

decision.zh: 每节点三个 Choice：普通/判断/终止角色、后继节点、否定分支节点，支持 none。
decision.en: Three Choices per node select role, next node and negative branch, including none.

action.zh: Worker校验选项和概率，解码为需复核图；代码拒绝不一致分支/无效边，用户审查后确定性生成 Mermaid 并渲染下载。
action.en: A Worker validates options/probabilities and decodes a review-required graph. Code rejects inconsistent branches/invalid edges, then deterministically emits Mermaid for rendering/download after review.

boundary.zh: 不是任意代码生成或自动执行业务流程；最多24问、8节点/16边，语义关系仍需人查。作者浏览器成功主要fixture，未证明部署或live模型质量，本站未上传文档或运行。
boundary.en: Not arbitrary code generation or business-flow execution. At most 24 questions, eight nodes and sixteen edges; semantic relations still need review. Author browser successes use fixtures rather than proving deployment/live quality. No documents uploaded or code run here.

title.zh: 图像异常研究：先框完整单元，再判断与显示
title.en: Image-anomaly research: frame whole units before judging and display

input.zh: 图像介质、原图与多尺度区域；保留完整词句、对象或整页上下文。
input.en: Image medium, original image and multi-scale regions, retaining whole words/objects or page context.

decision.zh: Jev1.14用Box找目标/完整单元，Choice在正常、异常类型和不确定中判断，临界答案重复并用另一问法确认。
decision.en: Jev 1.14 Boxes locate targets/whole units; Choices judge normality, anomaly types or uncertainty, repeating marginal answers and confirming with another format.

action.zh: 代码把窗口仅作线索、重新框完整语义单元后裁剪，合并重复框，最后定位显示并记录调用费用。
action.en: Code treats windows as leads, reframes/crops complete semantic units, merges duplicate boxes and localizes for display with call-cost records.

boundary.zh: 研究已记录切字、卡通及表格几何误报，v7b未重跑旧26图集；手选少图不能给生产准确率或AI来源归因。官方API实验且图片发提供商，作者结果/费用未复现，本站未上传或运行。
boundary.en: The study documents cut-word, cartoon and table-geometry false flags; v7b did not rerun the old 26-image set. Few handpicked images do not establish production accuracy or AI-origin attribution. Images reach an experimental API; author results/costs were not reproduced and no uploads/execution occurred here.

title.zh: 官方 Box 示例：定位目标后换算像素并裁剪
title.en: Official Box example: locate a target, convert to pixels and crop

input.zh: 厨房照片和待定位的咖啡杯目标；图像通过 assets 引用。
input.en: A kitchen photo and a coffee-mug target, with image references in assets.

decision.zh: Jev1.14 Box 返回上下左右归一化边；官方建议并行 Noul 判断目标是否存在。
decision.en: A Jev 1.14 Box returns normalized top/bottom/left/right edges, with an accompanying Noul recommended to check target presence.

action.zh: 示例代码将边界乘图片宽高，用PIL裁剪保存；低置信可先外扩并限在图内，边缘Noul可检查是否切断目标。
action.en: Example code multiplies edges by image dimensions and crops/saves with PIL; low-confidence boxes may be padded/clamped, with edge Nouls checking cut targets.

boundary.zh: 官方实验示例，需图像实验header，Box即使无目标也返回框，框不能证明存在。0.6阈值/0.05外扩仅教材起点，格式/效果可能变化，本站未发图或复现；非新cookbook。
boundary.en: Official experimental example requiring the image opt-in header. A Box returns edges even for an absent target, so it does not prove presence. The 0.6 threshold/0.05 padding are teaching defaults; formats/quality may change. No images sent or results reproduced here; not a new cookbook.

title.zh: 城市模拟：模型选动作，代码重查可行性
title.en: City simulation: model actions with coded feasibility rechecks

area.zh: 确定性模拟与决策回放

input.zh: 模拟市民的角色、需求、局部灾情与代码筛选的有限可行动作。
input.en: A simulated citizen’s role, needs, local hazards and a code-filtered finite action set.

decision.zh: 一条请求中Choice选下个动作，两Score评风险/义务，一Noul评是否中断日常。
decision.en: One request selects the next action with Choice, rates risk/duty with two Scores and judges routine interruption with a Noul.

action.zh: 服务端校验题型与分布，模拟器按请求ID接收并重新检查动作是否仍可行，再用代码执行移动和后果；回放、规则、live与安全覆盖分别标来源。
action.en: The server validates types/distributions; the simulator accepts by request ID, rechecks current feasibility and runs coded movement/effects, labelling replay, rules, live calls and safety overrides separately.

boundary.zh: 默认历史回放不发API；live失败显式用规则。4902次有效响应和延迟仅作者记录，不是现实城市/应急决策验证；本站未运行，真实调用需独立口令、密钥和预算配置。
boundary.en: Recorded replay is the default and makes no API calls; live failures visibly use rules. The 4,902 valid responses and timings are author records, not validation for real cities/emergencies. Not run here; live calls require separate passcode, credentials and budgets.

title.zh: Trace 检测：问题概率与类别分开保留
title.en: Trace detection: retain problem probability and category separately

input.zh: 解析后的trace spans及用户检测标准；超预算按固定次序截断并标记省略。
input.en: Parsed trace spans plus user detector criteria, with ordered reductions and omission markers when oversized.

decision.zh: 同请求Noul判断是否存在问题，Choice在模板类别、other、none中命名问题。
decision.en: A Noul judges problem presence and a Choice names a template category, other or none in the same request.

action.zh: 代码用0.5 gate产生identified，保留类别分布/置信；标签none则类别不明，摘要明确无文字理由。坏答案抛错，由检测分发层记录错误而非正常发现。
action.en: Code applies a 0.5 gate to identified and retains category distribution/confidence. A none label leaves the category unclear, with no written rationale; invalid answers throw and the dispatch layer records an error rather than a normal finding.

boundary.zh: 所核模块在Apache-2.0核心，ee目录另用商业许可；不包含企业聚类自动修复承诺。字符截断可能遗漏问题，示例阈值需本地评测，trace会发提供商；本站未提交真实trace或调用。
boundary.en: Reviewed modules are Apache-2.0 core; ee directories are commercially licensed, with no claim about enterprise grouping or automatic fixes. Character reductions can omit problems, thresholds need local evaluation and traces reach a provider. No real traces submitted or calls made here.

title.zh: 视觉影子评估：比较封闭答案，保留原工具结果
title.en: Vision shadow evaluation: compare bounded answers without replacing tool results

input.zh: 已有vision_analyze图片和封闭的PASS/FAIL或Yes/No问题；独立云端开关明确启用。
input.en: An existing vision_analyze image and a bounded PASS/FAIL or Yes/No question, with a separately enabled cloud switch.

decision.zh: TypeSafe Jev Choice检查图片；格式/尺寸预检、敏感问题跳过，并带官方图像实验header。
decision.en: A TypeSafe Jev Choice checks the image after format/size checks and sensitive-question skips, using the official experimental image header.

action.zh: 后台队列记录类别、置信、与原答案的一致性及假想混合结果；发送前再查开关，错误只记日志，原工具返回值不变。
action.en: A background queue records class, confidence, agreement and hypothetical hybrid results, rechecking the switch before sending. Errors only log; original tool results stay unchanged.

boundary.zh: 主线shadow不等于作者另一个分支18/18桌面动作演示；0.6沿用阈值未经该模型A/B，截图本身不能脱敏且会出机。官方视觉实验、本地Jev-Omni另算，本站未上传图片或运行。
boundary.en: Mainline shadow evaluation is separate from the author’s 18/18 branch desktop-action demo. The borrowed 0.6 threshold lacks its own A/B evidence; screenshots cannot be redacted automatically and leave the machine. Official vision is experimental and local Jev-Omni is separate. No images uploaded or code run here.

title.zh: 递归语言模型：Jev 返回概率，根程序计算与检索
title.en: Recursive language models: Jev returns probabilities for root-code computation and retrieval

input.zh: 逐条文本项、有限标签、问题和分窗的大文档；共享上下文与每项内容明确对应。
input.en: Individual text items, finite labels, questions and windowed documents, with explicit shared context/item association.

decision.zh: Choice分类、Noul是非；locate先Noul排窗口再评行句，返回原文offset与组合分数。
decision.en: Choice classification and Noul judgments; locate first ranks windows, then lines/sentences, returning original offsets and combined scores.

action.zh: 工具分批并发并校验缺失答案，向DSPy/自建RLM返回概率列表与原文片段，由根模型程序计数、筛选和回答；Jev部分独立计量。
action.en: Tools batch bounded concurrent calls, reject missing answers and return probabilities/original passages to DSPy or custom RLMs for root-code counting, filtering and answering, with separate Jev accounting.

boundary.zh: 研究库，小样本单次分数仅作者自报，Jev不生成或授权根程序。预算按token估算和固定费率，可能有误差且不含根模型费用，原文会发服务商；本站未运行模型/沙箱。
boundary.en: Research library with small single-run author results. Jev neither generates nor authorizes the root program. Token-estimate/fixed-rate budgets can err and exclude root-model costs; source text reaches providers. No models or sandbox programs run here.

title.zh: Grep 重排：逐段回答相关性，再输出原文位置
title.en: Grep reranking: judge snippets and return original locations

input.zh: grep模式得到的命中窗口、文件路径/行号和用户自然语言问题；每行送入文本最多300字符。
input.en: Grep-matched windows, file paths/line numbers and a natural-language question, with at most 300 characters per submitted line.

decision.zh: 直连Jev按段编号逐一Noul判断是否回答问题，最多32段/请求，有限并发。
decision.en: Direct Jev Nouls judge whether numbered snippets answer the question, at most 32 per request with bounded concurrency.

action.zh: 代码检查所有概率与回答数，按分值、路径、行号排序后输出原文及位置；错误停止，不输出部分排序。
action.en: Code validates probabilities/answer counts and sorts by score, path and line before returning original text/locations. Errors stop without partial ranked output.

boundary.zh: 只重排模式已命中的片段，不是全库语义召回。钉住主线已有实现，README发布版说明仍限密钥设置，已发布包/网关未验；片段会出机，0.4门槛需自评，本站未安装或调用。
boundary.en: Reranks only pattern matches, not full-corpus semantic recall. Pinned mainline implements it while release README text still limits the release to key setup; published packages/gateways are unverified. Snippets leave the machine and the 0.4 cutoff needs evaluation. Not installed or called here.

title.zh: 合成线索评测：有界动作与反馈记忆对照
title.en: Synthetic-lead evaluation: bounded actions with feedback-memory comparisons

input.zh: 生成的销售线索文本/字段、书面政策与策略提供的记忆；包含预设规则变化和带噪review。
input.en: Generated lead text/fields, written policy and strategy-supplied memory, including scripted policy shifts and noisy reviews.

decision.zh: 固定Jev模型Choice在AE、培育、自助、伙伴、淘汰五动作中选择；可另问记忆依据。
decision.en: A fixed Jev model chooses among AE routing, nurturing, self-service, partner or disqualification, optionally selecting a memory basis.

action.zh: 程序模拟动作结果并产生review，回写检索/SenseLab记忆与轨迹，执行配置的修复评测循环，生成对照报告；没有操作真实CRM。
action.en: Code simulates outcomes/reviews, updates retrieval or SenseLab memory/traces, runs configured repair-evaluation loops and generates comparison reports, without acting on a real CRM.

boundary.zh: 合成损失金额与准确率不是实际营收或本站实测；记忆更新不是Jev权重学习。API错误选首项且记error，不能当业务自动阻断；外部SenseLab/评测权限另需自备，本站未调用。
boundary.en: Synthetic losses/accuracy are neither real revenue nor site measurements; memory updates do not train Jev weights. API failures choose the first action with an error record, not business fail-closed handling. External SenseLab/eval access is separate. No calls made here.

title.zh: 下一步建议：Jev 选有限候选，按 Tab 才执行
title.en: Next-action suggestions: Jev selects bounded candidates for Tab-key acceptance

input.zh: 活动界面控件、近期操作及其他页面已有文本值，代码先构造候选动作。
input.en: Active controls, recent actions and values already visible on other pages, with candidate actions built in code.

decision.zh: Choice选下个控件或none，另以有限Choice选字段/下拉值；文本生成的Claude路径分开。
decision.en: A Choice selects the next control or none, with separate finite Choices for field/select values. The Claude text-generation path is separate.

action.zh: 代码显示可接受的ghost建议，用户按Tab才交执行器；相同界面慢/失败可回放缓存，已学重复流程另走零模型规则。
action.en: Code displays an acceptable ghost suggestion for Tab-key execution. Slow/failed calls may replay matching-screen caches, while learned repetitions use separate zero-model rules.

boundary.zh: hackathon原型，仅公开代码案例，根项目许可未确认。部分按钮置信被代码升至至少0.7，非原始模型概率；跨页面文本会出机。付款演示仅测试网且不证明支付安全，本站未运行、交易或验证原效果。
boundary.en: Hackathon prototype and public-code case only; root project license unconfirmed. Code boosts some button confidence to at least 0.7, not raw model probability, and cross-page text reaches the provider. Payment demos are testnet-only and do not establish payment safety. No execution, transactions or reproduced effects here.

title.zh: 浏览器屏蔽：政策判断转成有作用域的规则
title.en: Browser blocking: policy decisions become scoped rules

input.zh: 种子名单未覆盖的主机名、页面站点、资源类型/第一三方信息与用户政策，不发送完整URL或Cookie。
input.en: Uncovered hostnames, page site, resource/party metadata and user policy, without full URLs or cookies.

decision.zh: 每项两个Choice：block/allow和内容类别，最多八项一批。
decision.en: Two Choices per item select block/allow and a host category, batching at most eight items.

action.zh: 代码按block概率阈值缓存决定，编译站点/类型动态规则；用户覆盖与暂停优先，错误放行，跨站复用另可关闭。
action.en: Code thresholds/caches block decisions and compiles scoped dynamic rules. User overrides/pauses take priority, errors fail open and cross-site reuse can be disabled.

boundary.zh: MV3首请求可先通过，不能按路径过滤或隐藏元素。缺概率时解析会借用choice/confidence甚至默认值，可能误屏蔽；费用软帽、外部名单另许可，站点/域名出机。本站未安装/测试扩展。
boundary.en: MV3 first requests can pass before decisions; no path-level or cosmetic filtering. Missing probabilities fall back to choice/confidence or defaults and may overblock. Spend limits are soft, seed lists separately licensed and site/host metadata leaves the browser. Extension not installed or tested here.

title.zh: 语义代码检查：判断偏离，再定位原文片段
title.en: Semantic code checks: judge rule deviation and locate original excerpts

input.zh: 源码、Markdown规则与good/bad例子，以及配置允许的附加上下文。
input.en: Source code, Markdown rules/good-bad examples and configured additional context.

decision.zh: Noul判断规则偏离、适用/排除条件；Choice选段及首末代码行，Noul评上下文是否足够。
decision.en: Nouls judge deviation and inclusion/exclusion scope; Choices select sections/start-end lines and a Noul evaluates context sufficiency.

action.zh: 代码按规则阈值和scope筛选，校验位置后生成含原文/概率/上下文提示的报告并缓存；缺失回答不作为无问题缓存，不自动修源码。
action.en: Code filters by rule thresholds/scope, validates locations and reports original excerpts, probability and context hints with caching. Missing answers are not cached as clean results and source code is not automatically fixed.

boundary.zh: 概率和定位仍可错，不能代替确定性lint/编译器或安全保证；源文件与附加读取会发提供商，移动别名/缓存需维护。默认Jev与其他provider分开，作者评测未经本站复现，未运行。
boundary.en: Probabilities/locations may be wrong and do not replace deterministic lint, compilers or security guarantees. Source/additional reads reach providers; moving aliases/caches need maintenance. Default Jev and other providers are separate. Author evaluations not reproduced; not run here.

title.zh: 写作指标：有限判断与本地计算分工
title.en: Prose metrics: bounded judgments combined with local computation

area.zh: 文本指标与相对样本复读

input.zh: 英文全文、段落与词语，给定词类/体裁选项和有序评分等级。
input.en: English text, passages and words with supplied word-class/genre options and ordered rating levels.

decision.zh: Jev Choice/Score/Noul补本地不能确定的判断；全文/分段等级分布与体裁概率供组合模型使用。
decision.en: Jev Choice/Score/Noul questions supply judgments beyond local routes, with whole-text/chunk distributions and genre probabilities for combination models.

action.zh: 本地算术和预拟合权重生成指标，profile/compare按作者样本标出需复读的偏离；不可用时警告并重算本地集合，cadence独立且无模型调用。
action.en: Local arithmetic/fitted weights produce metrics; profile/compare flag deviations from author samples for rereading. Unavailable Jev triggers a warned local recomputation; cadence is separate and makes no model calls.

boundary.zh: 不是通用作文质量裁判，英文资源/训练样本限制适用范围，数据组件另有许可。作者验证未复现；全文会出机，jev-latest旧缓存可能过期，本站未提交文章或运行模型。
boundary.en: Not a universal writing-quality judge; English resources/fitting samples limit scope and data components have separate licenses. Author validation not reproduced. Text reaches providers and old jev-latest caches can age. No articles submitted or models run here.

title.zh: 模拟高尔夫：图像判断转成受阈值约束的解说事实
title.en: Simulator golf: turn image judgments into thresholded commentary facts

input.zh: 显式启用Jev后的模拟球场小地图截图和到旗距离；代码先找颜色/几何候选。
input.en: A simulator minimap crop and distance to pin after explicit Jev selection, with color/geometry candidates found in code.

decision.zh: Box定位球和旗，Noul确认水/沙/树等，Choice读有限数字与方位；带图像实验header。
decision.en: Boxes locate ball/pin, Nouls confirm water/sand/trees and Choices read finite digits/directions, using the experimental image header.

action.zh: 代码验证位置/置信、换算几何与距离并过滤事实/hazards，供解说模型和预先生成的条件分支使用；超时/失败回退其他视觉，语音由另一路TTS生成。
action.en: Code checks position/confidence, derives geometry/distances and filters facts/hazards for the commentary model and prewritten branches. Timeout/failure falls back to another vision model and separate TTS generates speech.

boundary.zh: Windows/GSPro截图环境专用，非现实球场安全导航；Box/图像仍实验，示例阈值/速度/费用仅作者口径且未复现。截图出机、其他LLM/TTS效果不算Jev结果，本站未抓图或运行。
boundary.en: Specific to Windows/GSPro screenshots, not real-course safety navigation. Boxes/images are experimental and example thresholds/timing/costs are author reports, not reproduced. Crops leave the machine; other LLM/TTS results are separate. No screenshots collected or code run here.
